RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel increases the risk of unconscious or affinity bias, but on its own, it does not prove sex discrimination. Laboratory head positions often prioritize broad executive leadership and operational management over advanced technical or academic credentials, which may explain the other candidate's selection. 

Do not lead by alleging bias. First, send a polite follow-up requesting your written feedback. If their justification cites vague, shifting, or purely subjective criteria despite your qualifications, you then have grounds to raise panel diversity and procedural fairness with HR. Raising it prematurely without documented feedback risks putting the hospital on the defensive and damaging your professional standing.
